modules.title: Strategic Marketing Insight
modules.summary: Embark on a journey of strategic marketing enlightenment with our comprehensive course. By mastering the principles, stages, and components of strategic marketing, you'll unlock the keys to crafting winning marketing strategies and driving business success. Whether you're a seasoned marketer looking to enhance your skills or a newcomer seeking to break into the field, this course equips you with the knowledge and expertise to thrive in today's competitive market landscape.

outcomes: The core principles underlying the strategic marketing process.
Identify and describe the key stages involved in strategic marketing.
The essential steps involved in conducting a comprehensive situation analysis for strategic marketing.
Classify and analyze the components of the Five C analysis framework used in strategic marketing.
The sequential steps are necessary for formulating effective marketing strategies.
The fundamental components and elements encompassing the marketing mix.
Explore and analyze the various factors that influence the dynamics of marketing strategy relationships.
